title: Ray Hernandez pulled out of his car in a Miami traffic jam

tellings.quote: and then two days later he's in this Miami. He's in a traffic jam completely stalled.

plain: A man named Rey Hernandez was sitting in a completely stalled traffic jam in Miami when, as the story goes, he was pulled out of his car. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells it second-hand, saying it happened two days after an earlier event in Hernandez's story, and ties it to Edgar Mitchell, the Apollo astronaut who walked on the moon. No date is given, and it is told as a strange encounter in the middle of an ordinary day.
